# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Module 15.5-A: Japan Sengoku & Shogunate Deep Overhaul (oe_jp2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v155_japan.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly dispatcher invoked from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_jp2_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_jp2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_jp2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_jp2_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_jp2_is_japan_host = yes
			}
			oe_jp2_country_yearly_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
}
